scope: VILLAGE_LIFE_PLAN.md sections 1-10, implementation decisions in section 11
corrections: Old profession/industry fixtures explicitly use developed villages. Legacy replay fixtures instantiate actual retained engines instead of feeding future save fields into old parsers.
Found and fixed guardian following distance, adulthood schedule cleanup, abandoned lesson reservations, and missing daily-view care links.

Large initial populations had child-only houses and, at 3000, child-only settlements. Rotate cohorts and swap household members while preserving capacity; verify all children at 12/300/1000/3000 have an adult at home.
Local-stock request and rent fixtures now identify the intended settlement and actual home rent instead of assuming old housing distribution.

Final browser run had one seed-dependent rescheduling fixture failure; seed 7 supplies a real recorded schedule change and recurring circle. All 3 gathering tests and 3 village-life tests passed on rerun.
initial_regression: village-life-regression-initial.json (pre-fix evidence, not the final implementation)
decisions: One guardian accompanies one young child, within the proposed maximum of three.
Natural physical collisions remain rare; forced boundary tests separately verify injury and adult-child exclusions.
Existing occupations, facilities, assets, and people remain; old injuries preserve the observed amount without inventing the past cause.
limits: Local Node timings are not production CPU or memory measurements.
Real Chrome model quality, Firefox/WebKit reruns, and human fun evaluation were not performed for this release.
Daily-sampled care wait measures only sampled active injuries, not every individual waiting-time maximum.
Some large or long-running checkpoints exceed the pre-existing 12 MB archive-state limit; internal chunked persistence and replay were validated, unrestricted archive download was not claimed.
review: Production UI, server authority, persistence compaction, old-engine replay and actual resource accounting reviewed; no external API policy changes.

long_regression.accounting: Food, wood, coins and every urban goods ledger balanced at each daily checkpoint
